content.comment_body: Hello everyone, can anyone recommend a suitable standard microSD card part number for [product_name] [version_no]?

You can use microSD cards from various well-known manufacturers, with a maximum supported size of 32 GB. Make sure to format the cards using FAT32, and use a full format rather than a quick format for best results.
The advice about using a full format seems especially important for some cards. I always use a complete format instead of a quick format just to be safe.
